mapper.update: /*updateMasterWmGiReleasePrPopICOMIVDT*/ UPDATE ICOMIVDT SET WMS_IVK_QTY = NVL(WMS_IVK_QTY,0) +#{IVK_QTY} WHERE BUYER =#{BUYER} AND INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND STATUS != 'D'

/*insertMasterWmGiReleasePrPopList*/ INSERT INTO WMSIVDT ( WAREHOUSE_CODE, SELLER, INV_NO, INV_SEQ, BUYER, STATUS, SEND_DATE, SEND_TIME, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CONFIRM_DATE, CONFIRM_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, STDCATLG_ID, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, PROCESS_TYPE, PO_QTY, GR_QTY, INV_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, LIST_PRICE, UNIT_AMT, LIST_AMT, ORIGIN_CODE, MAKER_NAME, AGENT, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ, REF_PR_NO, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PO_DATE, GR_DATE, INV_DATE, DELIVERY_QTY, DELIVERY_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_ID, DELIVERY_USER_ID, LEGACY_IV_SERIAL, DELIVERY_COMPANY, DELIVERY_NO , CMS_CATLG_ID, SCHEDULED_DATE, CAR_ID, CAR_NO, CAR_PERSON_NAME, CAR_PERSON_TEL, BOX_QTY ,
DELIVERY_PERSON, TAG_NO ) ( SELECT #{st_warehouse_code} AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, IVDT.SELLER AS SELLER, #{INVK_NO} AS INV_NO, (SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(TO_NUMBER(MAX(WD.INV_SEQ)),0)+1,'FM000000') FROM WMSIVDT WD WHERE WD.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WD.INV_NO = #{INVK_NO} )AS INV_SEQ, IVDT.BUYER AS BUYER, 'C' AS STATUS, '' AS SEND_DATE, '' AS SEND_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CONFIRM_DATE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CONFIRM_TIME, IVDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, IVDT.SELLER_ITEM_NO AS SELLER_ITEM_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, #{IVK_QTY} AS INV_QTY, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',(SELECT NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0) FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{STDCATLG_ID} AND PROCESS_TYPE = '1'),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0)) AS LIST_PRICE, ROUND(#{IVK_QTY} * NVL(PODT.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS UNIT_AMT, ROUND(#{IVK_QTY} * DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1',(SELECT NVL(STC_SELLER_PRICE,0) FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE=#{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID =#{STDCATLG_ID} AND PROCESS_TYPE = '1'),NVL(PODT.AGENT_PRICE,0))) AS LIST_AMT, PODT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE, PODT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','KRKORE0001','2',POHD.AGENT,'3',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE) AS AGENT, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS S_INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS S_INV_SEQ, PODT.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, PODT.PR_NO AS PR_NO, PODT.PR_SEQ AS PR_SEQ, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE, IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, #{IVK_DATE} AS INV_DATE, 0 AS DELIVERY_QTY, '' AS DELIVERY_DATE, #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID, #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID, '' AS DELIVERY_USER_ID, #{LEGACY_IV_SERIAL}, '' AS DELIVERY_COMPANY, '' AS DELIVERY_NO, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATELG_ID, NVL(#{SCHEDULED_DATE},F_GET_WORKINGDAY(to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD'),1)) AS SCHEDULED_DATE, #{CAR_ID}, #{CAR_NO}, #{CAR_PERSON_NAME}, #{CAR_PERSON_TEL}, #{BOX_QTY},
'' DELIVERY_PERSON, IVDT.TAG_NO AS TAG_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMIVHD IVHD WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PODT.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND IVDT.INV_NO =#{INV_NO} AND IVDT.INV_SEQ =#{INV_SEQ} AND PODT.BUYER = POHD.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = POHD.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ
AND IVDT.SELLER = IVHD.SELLER AND IVDT.BUYER = IVHD.BUYER AND IVDT.INV_NO = IVHD.INV_NO
AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVHD.STATUS <> 'D' )
mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmGiReleasePrPopList*/ SELECT PRDT.PR_NO, PRDT.PR_SEQ, PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',(NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)),(NVL(PODT.ITEM_QTY,0)-NVL(PODT.IV_QTY,0))) AS WMS_GW_QTY, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IVK_DATE, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,(SELECT AVAIL_QTY FROM WMSSTCK WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AND AGENT = DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'1','KRKORE0001','3',PODT.WAREHOUSE_CODE) )) WMS_GR_QTY, PODT.IV_QTY AS IV_QTY, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.UNIT_PRICE * (NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0) - NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) AS WMS_IVK_AMT, PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ, (SELECT DOC_TYPE FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER= PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO=PODT.PO_NO) AS DOC_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO), 'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, F_GET_WORKINGDAY(to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD'),1) AS SCHEDULED_DATE, CASE WHEN IVDT.BOX_QTY IS NULL OR IVDT.BOX_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE IVDT.BOX_QTY END BOX_QTY, IVDT.CAR_ID, IVDT.CAR_NO, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_NAME, IVDT.CAR_PERSON_TEL, PODT.DELAY_REMARK , F_GET_MSDS_INFO(PODT.BUYER, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,1) AS MSDS_NO, NVL(PRDT.DELY_BUNDLE_FLAG,'N') AS DELY_BUNDLE_FLAG, (SELECT COUNT(DELY_BUNDLE_FLAG) FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE A.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND A.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.DELY_BUNDLE_FLAG = 'Y') AS DELY_BUNDLE_CNT FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMIVDT IVDT, ICOMPRDT PRDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{st_BUYER} AND PODT.PR_NO = #{st_PR_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY WMS_GW_QTY DESC, DELY_BUNDLE_FLAG DESC,PODT.BUYER, PODT.PR_NO, PODT.PR_SEQ
